hook: Your QR code still scans after a scribble.
title: Your QR Code Still Scans After You Scribble
description:
QR codes carry built-in error correction, so a damaged code can still be read. At the highest setting, up to about 30% of a code can be lost. Try it with a pen and your phone camera, but heavy damage will break it.

#Shorts #QRCode #TechFacts
comment_prompt: Did your scribbled code still scan? Yes or no
